title: SA-RAG: Structuring Noisy Conversations for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2605.24366v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have been widely adopted in conversational applications. However, their reliance on parametric knowledge limits reliability in real-world scenarios that require dynamic or domain-specific information. Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) addresses this limitation by incorporating external knowledge during generation, but existing RAG methods often struggle with noisy or irrelevant contexts, as they typically assume that high-quality structures are already available. In this work, we propose Structure-aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation (SA-RAG), a principled structure induction and generation framework that constructs reliable intermediate structures directly from noisy conversational data. SA-RAG uses tables as compact and controllable structured representations. We introduce a quality-aware structure induction framework that jointly models semantic and structural consistency. translated_title: SA-RAG：为检索增强生成构建结构化的噪声对话
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）已被广泛应用于对话应用中。然而，其对参数化知识的依赖限制了其在需要动态或领域特定信息的真实场景中的可靠性。检索增强生成（RAG）通过在生成过程中引入外部知识来应对这一局限，但现有的RAG方法往往难以处理噪声或无关的上下文，因为它们通常假设高质量的结构已经可用。在这项工作中，我们提出了结构感知检索增强生成（SA-RAG），这是一个有原则的结构归纳与生成框架，能够直接从噪声对话数据中构建可靠的中间结构。SA-RAG使用表格作为紧凑且可控的结构化表示。我们引入了一个质量感知的结构归纳框架，联合建模语义一致性和结构一致性。此外，我们还探索了……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 提出SA-RAG框架，通过质量感知的结构归纳方法直接从噪声对话数据中构建表格形式的可靠中间结构，从而提升检索增强生成在嘈杂上下文中的表现。
en_tdlr: SA-RAG is a structure-aware RAG framework that constructs reliable table-based intermediate structures directly from noisy conversational data through quality-aware structure induction that jointly models semantic and structural consistency.
